set: A: surface and detail, the key `decision` and the page at rest, whole and in native crops

issues.where: the cursor arrow beside the red stamp
issues.what: it is a flat white shape with a dark outline, no thickness and no gloss, with soft fuzzy edges; its shadow is one soft blur that hugs the shape with no dark contact line and no separation, so it reads as a pasted sticker, not an object resting on the page
issues.fix: give the arrow a little body: a gloss highlight and a crisp edge, plus a shadow with a dark contact line at the surface that lightens as it falls off

issues.where: the Performance Metrics glass card, and the 'glass at its edge' crop in set-A-04.png
issues.what: the pale green glass is perfectly smooth and even with nothing showing through; it reads as a flat opaque panel rather than glass
issues.fix: add a subtle reflection streak, a faint gradient, and a hint of the paper grain refracting through the bevel at the edge

issues.where: the crop tile labeled 'the arrow, its edge and its shadow'
issues.what: the tile contains no arrow; it shows the bottom of the LED display and the two dots of an ellipsis, so the crop misses its subject
issues.fix: re-cut the tile onto the arrow, or relabel it if the at-rest picture has no arrow

issues.where: the orange 5 button at the end of the progress rail
issues.what: it butts against the rail with no socket and no gap and is flatter than the brushed-metal buttons beside it
issues.fix: seat it in a bezel with a dark gap all round and match the depth and gloss of the metal buttons
